identity_basis: user confirmed lower mass arginine, higher mass verapamil near455
normalization: 100*individual scan ion peak height/group mean peak height of same ion
comparison_limit: Observed exported-signal variability; Raw UI setting differs and instrument preprocessing is unverified.

methods.Source: D-ISO.xlsx and corrected L-ISO.xlsx; each 95000 data rows, 35 scans. Invalid initial empty L upload is not used.
methods.Ion identity: User assigned the lower mass strong peak to arginine and the higher peak near m/z455 to verapamil.
methods.D X axis: Raw sampling indices 0..94999; no verified m/z transformation provided. Extract original-index windows; do not report D absolute m/z.
methods.L X axis: File contains its own m/z grid, 50..999.989996. Use that grid directly.
methods.Extraction: Every scan maximum within a fixed ion/group window; D Arg[12000,13000], Ver[40000,41000]; L Arg[170,180], Ver[450,460].
methods.Robustness: For all scans, the same maxima are found within +/-45 data rows of each group/ion mean-spectrum peak. No competing dominant neighbor peak.
methods.Relative intensity: 100 * per-scan ion peak height / mean peak height of that ion in that D or L group. Group mean is 100%; individual scans are not each forced to 100%.
methods.Stability: RSD=100*sample SD/mean, ddof=1; smaller RSD means lower observed exported-signal variability.
methods.No extra processing: No scans deleted, no alignment, no smoothing, no fitting, no reconstructed signal, no baseline subtraction.
methods.Ratio supplement: Ver/Arg*100 is provided separately and is not the plotted independent Ver stability: its variability includes denominator fluctuations.
methods.Limits: UI Raw=True for D and False for L; Relative=False for both. Instrument processing behind that UI flag is unverified. Compare observed exported-signal variability, not proven intrinsic enantiomer or hardware stability.
methods.Chronology: X-axis Scan number follows source Y1..Y35. No acquisition timestamps or temporal-independence assumptions supplied.
methods.Renderer: Matplotlib, Arial; not rendered in native Origin. Origin-importable CSV supplied.
